tools.name: lookup_purchase_order
tools.description: Look up a purchase order, its lines, and goods received so far. Returns status 'found' with the purchase order header and lines (including received_qty), or status 'not_found'.

tools.name: check_duplicate_invoice
tools.description: Check whether a vendor has already submitted a given invoice number. Returns status 'duplicate' with the existing invoice, or 'no_duplicate'.

tools.name: get_invoice_status
tools.description: Look up the processing status of an invoice in the ERP. Returns status 'found' with matching invoice details (status, hold_reason, total_amount), or status 'not_found'.
